title: RBI LBS Norms — 60% Credit-Deposit (CD) Ratio Target for Rural Branches
summary: Revised Lead Bank Scheme (LBS) guidelines require banks to maintain a 60% CD ratio in rural and semi-urban branches.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI LBS Norms — 60% Credit-Deposit (CD) Ratio Target for Rural Branches. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI revised Lead Bank Scheme (LBS) norms, requiring banks to maintain a minimum **60% Credit-Deposit (CD) ratio** in rural and semi-urban branches.
**Monitoring Tiers**: CD ratio 40-60% monitored by DCC; <40% monitored by special sub-committee; <20% flagged as 'special category'.
**Unbanked Outlets**: Banks must open ≥25% of outlets in Tier V/VI unbanked rural centres.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
